method: Kinematic replay of saved valid traces in each isolated scene; no new physics. 'faithful' = simulated states; 'aligned' = saved relative motion re-anchored to the reference config's settled start. Camera fixed per geometry, framed on the union of both modes' trajectories. Centroids from MuJoCo segmentation masks.
caveats: Noiseless synthetic renders with known camera and action: an upper bound on what images can reveal.
Per-geometry camera framing uses that geometry's trajectory extent.
Mass and friction are synthetic simulator assignments.
